image_description: A side-profile view of a wood rabbit (cottontail) sitting on dry ground next to a large grey rock and some evergreen foliage. The rabbit has greyish-brown fur, long upright ears with pinkish interiors, and a visible white tail tuft. Its posture is alert, with hind legs tucked beneath the body and forelegs planted on the ground.
